# GitHub Release Template

## Release Title Format

`v1.0.0 - PowerPoint Dynamic References`

## Release Description Template

```markdown
# PowerPoint Dynamic References v1.0.0

A PowerPoint add-in that automates citation management and bibliography generation from BibTeX files.

## 📥 Download

**For Windows & MacOS:**

- [Dynamic_References.ppam](https://github.com/ThatDudeSebastian/PowerPoint-Dynamic-References/releases/download/v1.0.0/Dynamic_References.ppam) - PowerPoint Add-In file

## ✨ What's New in v1.0.0

- Initial release
- Automatic citation numbering from BibTeX files
- Dynamic bibliography generation
- Support for grouped shapes and special characters
- Spatial sorting (top-left to bottom-right)
- Citation history persistence

## 📦 Installation

1. Download `Dynamic_References.ppam` from the link above
2. Copy it to your PowerPoint add-ins folder:
   - **Windows**: `%APPDATA%\Microsoft\AddIns\`
   - **MacOS**: `~/Library/Group Containers/UBF8T346G9.Office/`
3. Open PowerPoint → `File` → `Options` → `Add-Ins` → Manage: `PowerPoint Add-ins` → `Go`
4. Click `Add New` and select `Dynamic_References.ppam`

For detailed instructions, see the [README](https://github.com/ThatDudeSebastian/PowerPoint-Dynamic-References#installation).
```

## Files to Attach

When creating a release on GitHub, attach these files:

1. **Dynamic_References.ppam** (required) - The main add-in file from `Add-In/`
2. **Source code (zip)** - Automatically generated by GitHub
3. **Source code (tar.gz)** - Automatically generated by GitHub

## How to Create a Release on GitHub

1. Go to your repository: `https://github.com/ThatDudeSebastian/PowerPoint-Dynamic-References`
2. Click on **"Releases"** in the right sidebar
3. Click **"Draft a new release"**
4. Fill in:
   - **Tag version**: `v1.0.0` (create new tag)
   - **Release title**: `v1.0.0 - PowerPoint Dynamic References`
   - **Description**: Use the template above
5. Click **"Attach binaries"** and upload `Dynamic_References.ppam`
6. Check **"Set as the latest release"**
7. Click **"Publish release"**

## Version Numbering

Use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/):

- **Major** (1.x.x): Breaking changes
- **Minor** (x.1.x): New features, backwards compatible
- **Patch** (x.x.1): Bug fixes

Examples:

- `v1.0.0` - Initial release
- `v1.1.0` - Added new citation format support
- `v1.0.1` - Fixed bug with grouped shapes
- `v2.0.0` - Changed ribbon UI structure (breaking change)

## Release Checklist

Before creating a release:

- [ ] Update version number in `src/UI.xml` (line 10: `Ver: 1.0.0`)
- [ ] Test the `.ppam` file on Windows
- [ ] Test the `.ppam` file on MacOS (if possible)
- [ ] Update README.md if needed
- [ ] Create a git tag: `git tag v1.0.0`
- [ ] Push the tag: `git push origin v1.0.0`
- [ ] Create the GitHub release
- [ ] Attach `Dynamic_References.ppam`
- [ ] Verify download link works
